08/08/2026: Logger / Station Maintenance:                                [1400] 
 
            - station maintenance, including: 
               - logger replacement (os downgrade: 32.07 -> 32.05)* 
               - logger program change (cth-bbad.cr1 -> cth-bbadC.cr1)** 
                
               * version 32.07 causes logger to reset after connecting with 
                 LoggerNet... haven't had this issue with 32.05. 
 
              ** added extra data table for debugging "phantom tips".

05/19/2024: Logger / Station Maintenance:                                [1500] 
  
            - routine site maintenance, including: 
               - replaced datalogger (to resolve faulty precipitation) 
                     - checked / cleaned atmp/relh sensor 
                     - checked soil sensors 
                     - sprayed wasp nest under solar panel 
                     - tested tipping-bucket rain gauge (good) 
                     - weed / grass removal around station  
               - loaded logger program: cth-bbad.cr1* (237 -> LWS-L)* 
                     * supports "maintenance mode"  
                     * sensor replaced: 06/27/2022 (faulty since: 08/16/2021) 
                     * cleaned up previously collected data

============================================================================== 
11/04/2009:  Station Maintenance: 
 
             - Loaded MAWN Program - ABCW (3-hour collection cycle)     [0001]  
 
 
 
08/21/2009:  Station Maintenance:                                       [1200] 
 
             - On 08/11/09 at 14:00, communication to/from the Chatham 
               datalogger was severed.    Rather than install/bury new 
               short-haul modem cable, this opportunity was used to  
               upgrade the Chatham station to the CELL-IP Network.  A 
               wireless broadband modem was installed before noon and 
               data-collection/monitoring is now controlled from the 
               EnviroWeather Office on the campus of Michigan State 
               University. 
 
             - MAWN Program - ABCF Loaded (60-minute power-cycle). 
 
             - Added Hourly Battery Voltage to MAWN Database tables 
               for Chatham. 
 
 
 
04/27/2009:  Station Maintenance: 
 
             - Snowfall adapter was removed. 
 
 
 
 
 
============================================================================== 
10/10/2007:  Station Maintenance: 
 
             - Recent telecommunications with the data-collection PC 
               for the Chatham station have been repaired.  As of  
               10:10am this morning, data is flowing once again.  No 
               data was lost during the temporary outage.

10/24/2006:  Station Maintenance: 
 
             - Snowfall adapter for Tipping Bucket Rain Gauge Installed. 
 
               NOTE: Timing and amount of precip over the past couple of days  
                     may be slightly off as there was some frozen precipitation 
                     prior to the installation of the snowfall adapter.  It 
                     was reported that 1.44" of precipitation fell between  
                     10/22/06 - 10/26/06.
